verses.text: For the one directing. According to “The Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to the soul.

segments.text: For the one directing. According to “The Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to the soul.

verses.text: I sink in the mire of the deep, and there is no place to stand; I have come into the depths of the waters, and a flood washes over me.

segments.text: I sink in the mire of the deep, and there is no place to stand; I have come into the depths of the waters, and a flood washes over me.

verses.text: I have grown weary with my calling out; my throat is dry; my eyes fail, waiting for my God.

segments.text: I have grown weary with my calling out; my throat is dry; my eyes fail, waiting for my God.

verses.text: Those hating me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those seeking my destruction, my enemies [with] deception! That which I did not steal, I must then return.

segments.text: Those hating me without cause outnumber the hairs of my head; many are those seeking my destruction, my enemies [with] deception! That which I did not steal, I must then return.

verses.text: O God, You know of my foolishness, and my guilt [is] not hidden from You.

segments.text: O God, You know of my foolishness, and my guilt [is] not hidden from You.

verses.text: Do not let those waiting on You come to shame because of me, O Lord YHWH of hosts; do not let those seeking You be disgraced because of me, O God of Israel!

segments.text: Do not let those waiting on You come to shame because of me, O Lord YHWH of hosts; do not let those seeking You be disgraced because of me, O God of Israel!

verses.text: [It is] for Your sake that I have carried scorn, [and] shame has covered my face.

segments.text: [It is] for Your sake that I have carried scorn, [and] shame has covered my face.

verses.text: I have become a stranger to my brothers, and a foreigner to the sons of my mother.

segments.text: I have become a stranger to my brothers, and a foreigner to the sons of my mother.

verses.text: For zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those insulting You have fallen on me.

segments.text: For zeal for Your house has consumed me, and the insults of those insulting You have fallen on me.

verses.text: I even wept in the fasting of my soul, and it was for a reproach to me.

segments.text: I even wept in the fasting of my soul, and it was for a reproach to me.

verses.text: I made my clothing sackcloth, and I became to them as a byword.

segments.text: I made my clothing sackcloth, and I became to them as a byword.

verses.text: Those sitting [at] the gate meditate against me, and I am the song of those drinking wine.

segments.text: Those sitting [at] the gate meditate against me, and I am the song of those drinking wine.

verses.text: And I—my prayer [is] to You, O YHWH; [in] the time of favor, O God, in the abundance of Your loving devotion, may You answer me in the truth of Your salvation!

segments.text: And I—my prayer [is] to You, O YHWH; [in] the time of favor, O God, in the abundance of Your loving devotion, may You answer me in the truth of Your salvation!

verses.text: Deliver me from the mire, that I should not sink! May I be delivered from those hating me, and out of the depths of the waters.

segments.text: Deliver me from the mire, that I should not sink! May I be delivered from those hating me, and out of the depths of the waters.

verses.text: Do not let the flood of waters engulf me, and do not let the deep swallow me up, and do not let the pit shut its mouth over me!

segments.text: Do not let the flood of waters engulf me, and do not let the deep swallow me up, and do not let the pit shut its mouth over me!

verses.text: Answer me, O YHWH, for good [is] Your loving devotion; according to the abundance of Your tender mercies, turn to me.

segments.text: Answer me, O YHWH, for good [is] Your loving devotion; according to the abundance of Your tender mercies, turn to me.

verses.text: And do not hide Your face from Your servant, for distress [is] unto me; hurry to answer me!

segments.text: And do not hide Your face from Your servant, for distress [is] unto me; hurry to answer me!

verses.text: Draw near to my soul [and] redeem it; on account of my enemies, may You ransom me.

segments.text: Draw near to my soul [and] redeem it; on account of my enemies, may You ransom me.

verses.text: You know my scorn, and my shame, and my disgrace; all my adversaries [are] before You.

segments.text: You know my scorn, and my shame, and my disgrace; all my adversaries [are] before You.

verses.text: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am sick. And I looked for a bemoaner, and there was none, and for comforters, and I found none.

segments.text: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am sick. And I looked for a bemoaner, and there was none, and for comforters, and I found none.

verses.text: And they gave gall for my food, and for my thirst they made me drink vinegar.

segments.text: And they gave gall for my food, and for my thirst they made me drink vinegar.

verses.text: May their table before them become a snare, and for a recompense—for a trap!

segments.text: May their table before them become a snare, and for a recompense—for a trap!

verses.text: May their eyes grow dark from seeing, and their backs be bent forever!

segments.text: May their eyes grow dark from seeing, and their backs be bent forever!

verses.text: Pour out upon them Your indignation, and may the burning of Your anger overtake them!

segments.text: Pour out upon them Your indignation, and may the burning of Your anger overtake them!

verses.text: May their encampment become desolate; may there be no one dwelling in their tents.

segments.text: May their encampment become desolate; may there be no one dwelling in their tents.

verses.text: For You—the one whom You struck—they pursue, and the pain of those You pierced they recount.

segments.text: For You—the one whom You struck—they pursue, and the pain of those You pierced they recount.

verses.text: May You add iniquity to their iniquity, and do not let them come into Your righteousness!

segments.text: May You add iniquity to their iniquity, and do not let them come into Your righteousness!

verses.text: May they be blotted out from the book of the living, and do not let them be written with the righteous!

segments.text: May they be blotted out from the book of the living, and do not let them be written with the righteous!

verses.text: And I [am] afflicted and pained; may Your salvation, O God, set me on high.

segments.text: And I [am] afflicted and pained; may Your salvation, O God, set me on high.

verses.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will I magnify Him with thanksgiving.

segments.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will I magnify Him with thanksgiving.

verses.text: And it is better to YHWH than an ox, a bull horned [and] hoofed.

segments.text: And it is better to YHWH than an ox, a bull horned [and] hoofed.

verses.text: For YHWH listens to the needy, and he has not despised His captives.

verses.text: Let the heavens and earth shout praise to Him, the seas, and all [that is] crawling in them.

verses.text: For God will save Zion, and He will rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.
